title: Adding an Invoice to an Accepted Patient Payment Plan
content:
On **Patient Payment Plans**, when an invoice is added to a plan already accepted, the invoice comes onto the plan at its balance due and the plan's regular installment is set anew on the day of the enrollment, as this rule sets out.

## Before the installment is fixed

Before the installment of a plan taking on another invoice is fixed, the relief installment owed for a financial-assistance release already standing on the plan ledger is set.

The installment of a plan taking on another invoice is fixed only after the plan ledger carries the down payment owed on that invoice, posted as a down payment dated after the plan's acceptance date.

Applied to the plan ledger, these clauses mean:
- where the plan ledger already shows a release for a financial-assistance adjustment, the new installment of the plan taking on the invoice is fixed only once the relief installment owed for that release has been set;
- where a down payment is owed on the invoice being added, the new installment is fixed only once the plan ledger shows a down-payment line for it dated after the date the plan was accepted. A down-payment line dated on or before the acceptance date does not meet this clause.

## How the enrollment is booked
The enrollment is booked with the agent-side tool `add_invoice_to_plan_14a3a600`. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call puts one more of the patient's invoices on their existing payment plan: it books the invoice's balance onto the plan's activity as an enrollment dated today, raises the plan's remaining balance by that amount and sets the plan's new regular monthly installment. The due day, the automatic-payment setup and the plan status are left as they are. The patient sees the invoice listed on the plan and the new installment on the next statement.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | The reference number of the patient's payment plan, as the payment-plan lookup shows it | Identifier |
| `invoice_id` | The reference number of the invoice being put on the plan, as the invoice lookup shows it | Identifier |
| `enrolled_amount` | The invoice balance carried onto the plan | USD, a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `installment_amount` | The new regular monthly installment of the plan | USD, a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

## Return
On success the tool returns `enrollment_id` (the reference of the enrollment line), `plan_id`, `invoice_id`, `enrolled_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `plan_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the plan's remaining balance including the invoice) and `installment_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places). A returned `enrollment_id` means the invoice is on the plan.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)
An open invoice with a balance due of 412.30 is added to an accepted plan. The call passes the plan's reference, the invoice's reference, an `enrolled_amount` of 412.30 and the plan's new installment; the receipt shows the enrollment reference, the plan balance raised by 412.30 and the installment now on the plan.
